title: Harrier GR.7 / GR.9

sources.title: JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: The Harrier GR.7 and GR.9 are the British versions of the AV-8B Night Attack Harrier, flown by the RAF and the Royal Navy until 2011. They have British radios and avionics, a FLIR night camera and a moving map; the GR.9 added a new mission computer and newer bombs and missiles. JoyPro assumes the stick and throttle follow the AV-8B Night Attack, so this guide uses the DCS AV-8B cockpit; British switch functions are not checked. The radar switches and the waypoint button of the American grips are left out.
